description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katubedda, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No.520205
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to parcel numbers, land extents, village names, Grama Niladhari divisions, and servitude rights for various land plots in different districts. The content is purely land and property-related, focusing on title registration amendments without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other non-land administrative matters.
